clauses.reason: Section 6 of EO 11460 of March 20, 1969 (34 FR 5535, held Federal Register text) states "Executive Order No. 10938 of May 4,1961, is hereby revoked." EO 11460 has no deferred-effect or savings wording in its sections 1 to 6, so the revocation took effect on signing, March 20, 1969. The clause is therefore terminated by presidential express revocation on 1969-03-20 (the exclusive and inclusive readings do not differ, since there is no until date). The held U.S. Code note at 50 U.S.C. 3023 agrees that EO 11460 revoked EO 10938 on Mar. 20, 1969.

research_rationale:
EO 10938 (26 FR 3951, May 4, 1961; held official Federal Register text) established the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board (sec. 1), set its review and reporting duties (sec. 2), provided for its members and payment (sec. 3) and revoked EO 10656 (sec. 4, inside the inventory span of the third clause). Section 6 of EO 11460 (March 20, 1969; 34 FR 5535) states "Executive Order No. 10938 of May 4,1961, is hereby revoked." and the same order re-establishes a Board under its own terms. The first and last end of every clause is therefore 1969-03-20 and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14. The held U.S. Code editorial note at 50 U.S.C. 3023 says EO 10938 was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 11460, Mar. 20, 1969, which agrees.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Searched the held texts citing EO 10938 by number: EO 11460 (APP transcription and Federal Register text) is the only later instrument; the other hits are the order's own text and a duplicate file. The order has no sunset or condition. Own-term leads (reports every six months, payment from the Special Projects appropriation for 1961 and later years) are continuing duties, not ends. No earlier abolition, termination or amendment of the Board is held, so nothing precedes 1969-03-20.","independent_command_check":"EO 11460 re-establishes the Board with similar duties, but under its own sections 1 to 5; those are new commands of EO 11460, not continuation of EO 10938. The Board, its advisory duty, the access-to-information duty and the payment rule of EO 10938 all fall with the revocation, and nothing in EO 11460 keeps any of them in force under EO 10938.","savings_check":"EO 11460 contains no savings clause (sections 1 to 6 read). Members appointed under EO 10938 are not said to continue. The only surviving legal effect of EO 10938 is the earlier revocation of EO 10656 (section 4), which is a completed act and independent of the order's force.","scope_check":"The revocation names the whole order by number and date; it is not a revocation of a part and has no qualifier. EO 10938 section 4 revoked EO 10656, which is a completed one-time revocation executed on signing in 1961 and is not revived by the later revocation of EO 10938; that act sits inside the third clause span, whose continuing commands (compensation and payment) end on 1969-03-20."}

savings.reason: EO 11460 has no saving provision; the bounded U.S. Code, eCFR and OFR catalog searches show only the revocation (the U.S. Code note at 50 U.S.C. 3023 repeats it) and no citation of EO 10938 as a current authority.
